**Diagnostics**

In Perry: Settings → Memory & Privacy → **Export redacted diagnostics**. Save the
file and attach it here by dragging it into this issue. Perry never uploads it
automatically — attaching is always your choice. The export contains no
requests, transcripts, memory text, or file paths.
